task: EXT-F-1003-T40 native page-load auto-scrape adapter source audit

source_proof.preview_builder: src/features/chat/ContextRulesComposerChip.tsx calls buildChatContextValues and stores contextRowSources(values) in useContextRulesStore; this is the no-send path.
source_proof.content_value: The default v2-bundled builder emits page_full_content only when a trustworthy scrape is available. It can contain the unique controlled-page marker.
source_proof.rendered_table: The installed @ai-matrx/agents ContextRulesTable renders item label, inclusion, and character count; raw row values are intentionally not rendered.
source_proof.detail_loader: ContextRulesPanelBody supports optional loadView to fetch exact text, but ContextRulesComposerChip does not pass loadView. The current full-value view therefore cannot provide the page text to a CDP DOM reader.
source_proof.unsupported_shortcut: No helper was added that fabricates rendered page text, inspects private React state, or treats row presence/character count as proof of a unique marker.
source_proof.canonical_consumer_action: @ai-matrx/agents CHANGELOG0.29.0 requires loadView for next-turn POST /ai/context/preview and sent-turn GET /ai/context/delivered; the package already supplies the UI. No new product surface is required merely to replace it.

missing_native_trigger: An adapter needs a supported rendered value-view path for the no-send preview that returns exact page_full_content and a completion/document identity signal. With that surface, a fresh page after enabling and no manual capture can prove the unique marker; OFF can inspect complete preview state for absent page_full_content during a bounded window.
limits: The absence of a Page content row or its character count cannot prove the marker text was captured or omitted.
A bounded OFF observation can only establish absence during the observed interval.
